purpose: Prevent PR #311 review from acting as the first adversarial parser by proving all sixty-one Connector findings through source-copy identity, support-authority, support-state, support-reviewability, primary-marker and outcome validity, Markdown semantics, inventory currentness, firewall-matrix routing, write-set receipts, classifier precision, and executable-fixture families before another review request.
reference_effectiveness_note: The first repair reference set covered the five original literal examples but was ineffective against sibling repository text suffixes, benign authority-verb targets, packet-level authority placement, keywordless non-Stage-1 state, and dead fixture control flow. The second repair proved those ten comments but did not require per-support-artifact reviewability, model natural supporting-subject variants, distinguish gated actions from analysis/planning/inspection nouns, execute the documented default firewall against the changed matrix, keep the durable write-set receipt synchronized, or require fixture context around common review prose. The third repair proved those sixteen comments but did not exclude indented code and HTML comments from semantic authority scans or validate the branch receipt in detached HEAD checkouts. The fourth repair proved those eighteen comments but still relied on matrix registration for detached receipt discovery, omitted direct allows/allowed authority forms, and did not compare the generated inventory against final receipt content. The fifth repair proved those twenty-one comments but collapsed paragraph boundaries in bare authority scans, activated PR-specific classifiers outside their selected matrix, conditioned receipt-inventory currentness on the generated audit already being changed, accepted prefix-only Stage 1 primary markers, and accepted duplicate Intended Write Set fields. The sixth repair proved those twenty-six comments but did not scan coordinated authority targets after benign objects, mask inline Markdown code, distinguish approved primary authority from support authority, limit exact write-set enforcement to active receipts, or identify each generated inventory line-count surface independently. The seventh repair proved those thirty-one comments but truncated valid current receipt sections after an embedded historical section, rejected normal bulleted Intended Write Set fields, and treated post-verb no/neither/not target clauses as positive authority. The eighth repair proved those thirty-four comments but omitted affirmative modal authority forms and trusted USER_BRANCH_PLAN_REVIEW.md by basename instead of enforcing its exact Review Aids support location. The ninth repair proved those thirty-six comments but allowed affirmative adverbs before direct, modal, or emphatic-do authority verbs. The tenth repair proved those thirty-seven comments but treated deletion or rename of a historical receipt as an active-receipt failure, omitted bare Supporting context and Review aid authority subjects, and recognized only noun forms of implementation, PR creation, merge, and release targets. The eleventh repair proved the forty inline comments but the live churn helper ignored substantive Connector review-summary bodies and Stage 1 validators searched whole-document prose instead of validating the canonical Stage 1 Outcome value. The twelfth repair proved forty-one findings but omitted passive supporting-context agent variants, automatically selected deleted historical matrices, and did not require generated-inventory removal of deleted receipt paths. The thirteenth repair proved forty-four findings but retained a basename exception for non-Stage-1 support state, masked inline code one line at a time, treated green words inside finding prose as a standalone approval, and normalized intentional bare carriage returns. The fourteenth repair proved forty-eight findings but omitted past, perfect, progressive, and passive-infinitive authority predicates, ignored list-prefixed state fields, rejected the repository's exact established green response, and allowed an active receipt to drop its classification markers without an explicit historical transition. The fifteenth repair proved fifty-two findings but left target-first passive authority claims without past, perfect, and modal auxiliaries, discarded contradictory Stage 1 outcome qualifiers, and compared regenerated inventory counts without comparing all receipt-derived content surfaces. The sixteenth repair proved fifty-five findings but erased code-formatted contract values while masking examples, treated generic receipt wording as write-set evidence, left the committed branch receipt in an active posture, and ignored the caller's comparison base during nested inventory rendering. The seventeenth repair proved fifty-nine findings but missed instrumental use-to-authorize constructions and treated semicolons as negation resets under an earlier predicate. This matrix now binds all sixty-one live Connector findings to executable local proof for all eleven observed families.
